summary: Verified new features: (1) create-campaign-live announces once via background task (notification type campaign_live with campaign_id, live_announced_at flag set on doc, broadcasts entry kind=campaign_live audience=all). (2) PATCH status paused->live does NOT re-emit notification (one-time only, guarded by live_announced_at claim). (3) GET /api/banners returns auto-<cid> entry with image_url '', logo_url/company for live campaign without banner. (4) OfferBanners frontend renders offer-banner-generated slide (screenshot verified) with data-auto=1 href /api/go/<slug>?ref=<referral_code>. (5) Report notification stores report_id and DELETE /api/admin/reports/{id} removes the report notification from customer's notifications and hides the report. All 6 pytest tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1049 — announce_campaign_live sends emails sequentially with `await` inside a for-loop; with N verified customers and Emergent email rate limits (429 -> 3 retries ~10s each), this task can occupy the event loop for many minutes and left backend visibly unresponsive during preview testing when 100+ stale test customers existed. Consider asyncio.gather with a bounded semaphore (e.g. 5 concurrent) OR sending emails in a separate fire-and-forget batch to keep the announce task short.

server.py:988 create_campaign — background.add_task(announce_campaign_live, ...) is only added when status=='live' and offer_enabled True. If the admin creates a live-but-offer_disabled campaign, no announcement fires — intended, but consider announcing later when offer is toggled on (currently toggle-offer at 1058 does not trigger announce).

server.py:1026 update_campaign_status — announce only fires on paused->live/closed->live if never announced; correct. But because live_announced_at is claimed atomically inside announce_campaign_live, two rapid PATCH live calls could still both spawn background tasks; only one will insert notifications/broadcast, but the second still runs a users query. Minor.

OfferBanners.jsx:34/36 — data-testid only present on the ACTIVE slide, which makes automated detection depend on slider index. Consider adding a stable non-active variant testid like offer-banner-slide with a data-type='generated'|'image' attribute, in addition to the active-only testid, to make E2E tests easier.

server.py:1252 — auto-banner query filters `show_in_slider: {$ne: False}` (good). Consider also excluding campaigns already covered by manual banner via link slug (currently only campaign_id-linked manual banners are dedup'd; a manual banner using link='/campaign/<slug>' won't dedup).
